name: Spiraling Comets
disable: DC 42 Religion check (master) to command each comet to disperse with Pharasmin prayers, or Dispel Magic (8th rank; counteract DC 42) to counteract each comet
routine: (3 action) The trap loses 1 action each turn for each comet disabled, counteracted, or destroyed. Each comet uses 1 action to attack the nearest intruder with a comet Strike.

items.name: Intruder Alert
items.text:
Trigger An intruder enters the room

---

Effect The comets change from blue to red in color. The trap then rolls initiative.

text: Three blue comets orbiting the room turn red and attack when intruders enter.
